fact: The meteorology unit of the Department of Water Resources received and had installed Meteosat Third Generation PUMA and ClimSA stations at a handover on 30 August 2024, enabling continued reception of MTG data and satellite imagery, funded by the EU through the African Union Commission.
The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Gambia among 41 of 49 member states with a PUMA station installed as at 12 May 2026; the station carries satellite imagery.
